failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the mean of the last 28 days.

failure_condition: TRANSIT rises above -30% but RETAIL_REC does not increase over the subsequent two weeks.

failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility continues to decrease while WORKPLACES mobility increases, but RETAIL_REC declines over the next four weeks.

failure_condition: PARKS mobility rises above -3% but RETAIL_REC does not increase in the following week.
